description: List open times for a free call with Rahul D Sarker (fractional CMO and RevOps consultant), live from his calendar. Each time comes with a link that opens the booking form with that time selected; the person confirms and books on the site. Use when someone wants to talk to Rahul, get help with their marketing or RevOps, or book a consultation.
